title: [AAPS 2.8.1.1 and 2.8.2] Password necessary to export the configuration
body:
Before and after installing AAPS 2.8.2 over my AAPS 2.8.1.1 installation, I have to enter a master password. But I have disabled this master password for the configuration export.
Kind regards.

comments.body: i don't understand you question/issue properly

@winni67 In all version they can remember,  you need a master password to export or import settings. The password encrypt and protect your data's, for example the nightscout account.... The disabled function is only to change setting without enter the password. 

Where you see an issue here?

@rICTx-T1D Thats not true. To export an unencrypted setting in the last versions (2.7), it was not necessary to enter a master password. For me, that was the way to see, if I export unencrypted or encrypted. This is a change in the behavior and perhaps an issue.

@MilosKozak To enter the master password for an unencrypted setting is new to AAPS 2.8. In AAPS 2.7 it was not necessary. Is this a new feature or is this an issue? Now I can‘t see if the exported file is encrypted or unencrypted, because the password is now necessary for both export versions.

it's not possible to export with old unencrypted format anymore.
you have to provide password
